summary.reason: No vulnerabilities can be safely remediated automatically because previous automated patch attempts for all identified vulnerabilities collectively caused a Maven build failure during validation. The fixed versions either proved incompatible or represent major version upgrades requiring broader changes beyond POM-only modifications.
